an3.30:1.3: Avakujjapañño puggalo, ucchaṅgapañño puggalo, puthupañño puggalo.
an3.30:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammasavanāya.
an3.30:1.6: Tassa bhikkhū dhammaṃ desenti ādi kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsenti.
an3.30:1.7: So tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti na majjhaṃ manasikaroti, na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti,
an3.30:1.8: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti . . . pe . . . na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti.
an3.30:1.9: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho nikkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ vivaṭṭati no saṇṭhāti,
an3.30:1.10: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.30:1.13: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti . . . pe . . . na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti.
an3.30:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.30:2.4: So tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya ādim pi manasikaroti . . . pe . . . pariyosānam pi manasikaroti,
an3.30:2.5: vuṭṭhito ca kho tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva adim manasikaroti . . . pe . . . na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti.
an3.30:2.6: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave purisassa ucchaṅge nānākhajjakāni ākiṇṇāni
an3.30:2.8: so tamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahanto satisammosā pakireyya,
an3.30:2.9: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti . . .
an3.30:2.12: vuṭṭhito ca kho tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti . . . pe . . . na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti.
an3.30:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti . . . pe . . .
an3.30:3.4: So tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya adim pi manasikaroti . . . pe . . . pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti,
an3.30:3.5: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya ādim pi manasikaroti . . . pe . . . pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti.
an3.30:3.6: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho ukkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ saṇṭhāti no vivaṭṭati,
an3.30:3.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti . . .
an3.30:3.10: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya ādim pi manasikaroti . . . pe . . . pariyosānam pi manasikaroti.
an3.30:3.12: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti.
